study_identification_part.si4_title: Brain-Charting Autism and Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder Reveals Distinct and Overlapping Neurobiology

cm1_clarity_of_research_objectives.reason: The abstract explicitly states the aims: to use population (normative) modeling on a large multisite dataset to characterize cortical anatomy in autism and ADHD, benchmarked against average development, and to examine sex effects, age effects, trait relationships, and co-occurrence. These objectives directly map onto the stated research questions and intended applications of normative modeling.
cm1_clarity_of_research_objectives.supporting_text: Here, we used population modeling and a large, multisite neuroimaging dataset ... to characterize cortical anatomy associated with autism and ADHD, benchmarked against models of average brain development... We also examined sex and age differences and relationship with autistic traits and explored the co-occurrence of autism and ADHD.

nm1_clarity_of_inclusion_and_exclusion_c.reason: Control participants are defined as individuals with MRI data and no diagnosis from the listed datasets, and QC thresholds (manual FSQC cutoff 2.5) were applied with resulting sample sizes reported. However, beyond the absence of diagnosis and imaging QC, detailed health-related inclusion/exclusion criteria for controls are not described.
nm1_clarity_of_inclusion_and_exclusion_c.supporting_text: Individuals with magnetic resonance imaging data and a primary diagnosis of autism or ADHD or no diagnosis were included... The final dataset after quality control (QC) included 4255 individuals (1869 typically developing control participants...). / All scans underwent manual QC... A cutoff of 2.5 was used for FSQC....

nm2_handling_of_confounding_variables_in.reason: Key confounders were measured and adjusted: ComBat harmonization modeled site effects with age, sex, and diagnosis as covariates; analyses included Euler number and age; the reference models also accounted for site/scanner effects. This demonstrates explicit handling of age, sex, and site-related confounding.
nm2_handling_of_confounding_variables_in.supporting_text: ComBat was applied to the entire dataset across all global and regional measures, with each site treated as a batch and with covariates of age, sex, and diagnosis to preserve related biological variation. / All analyses included Euler number as a covariate, as well as age... / ...developmental trajectories...accounting for site- and scanner-specific variables (98).

nm4_description_of_image_acquisition_pro.reason: Imaging data were drawn from existing multisite datasets rather than newly collected in this study, so acquisition protocol reporting is not required under the NA condition.

nm5_details_of_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing steps are specified: T1 images processed with FreeSurfer v6.0.1 using Desikan-Killiany parcellation, hemispheric averaging, manual QC with FSQC cutoff 2.5, inclusion of Euler number, and ComBat harmonization before centile estimation. Software and QC thresholds are explicitly given.
nm5_details_of_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: T1 images from each dataset were processed using FreeSurfer, version 6.0.1... measures were averaged across hemispheres for each parcellation. / All scans underwent manual QC... using our FSQC tool...
